Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Free Speech, AI Slop, and Media Power - Episode 661 of the Community Broadband Bits Podcast By Jordan Pittman on Oct 3, 2025 In this episode of the podcast, Chris is joined by freelance journalist Karl Bode and ILSR’s Jordan Pittman for a wide-ranging conversation about the future of the Internet. They dig into the dangers of government overreach on free expression, the precarious role of Section 230, and how media consolidation threatens independent journalism. The group also unpacks the rise of “AI slop” — low-quality, automated content flooding our feeds — and what it means for media literacy, democracy, and the way younger generations navigate the online world. This episode was recorded on September 22nd when J immy Kimmel Live! was still suspended by ABC This show is 31 minutes long and can be played on this page or via Apple Podcasts or the tool of your choice using this feed .
